rationale: Repo-grounding audit at f120c599. Five of the six assigned claim clusters verify cleanly against the tree; the plan's line citations are uniformly accurate. The one defect is load-bearing: OQ-1(a)'s 'measurement equivalence' rationale — 'the content measured pre-commit is identical to the content the commits then materialize' — is false for UNTRACKED files under every diff primitive the codebase ships. CommitAll funnels to commitWithExport (mindspec_executor.go:1473-1494) whose own doc comment names `git add -A` + `git commit`, so it commits untracked files; the existing working-tree-vs-base measurement idiom the plan would naturally reuse (ValidateDocsRange head=="" -> getChangedFiles -> gitutil.DiffNameOnlyRef, gitops.go:1351-1365, plain `git diff --name-only <ref> --`) is blind to untracked files. A bead worktree at complete time routinely carries brand-new files (new test/source files, new doc files) that only the --commit-msg CommitAll will materialize. Consequences cut both ways: (1) false PASS — a new untracked source file with no doc update is invisible to the reordered gate but IS committed, a regression against exactly the property ADR-0041 §1 protects and today's post-commit base..beadHead range does catch; (2) false FAIL — a new untracked doc file accompanying tracked source changes is invisible, so doc-sync refuses work that the commit would have documented. The variant IS buildable (union `git status --porcelain` untracked entries into the changed list, or `git add --intent-to-add` before the diff), but the plan does not specify it, and both bead 6 and the pre-drafted ADR-0041 amendment rest their rationale on the unqualified equivalence claim. This is precisely the class of gap a plan gate exists to catch before implementation; one concrete change fixes it. Everything else grounded: complete.go:634/:646/:704 late-bound beadHead and the :815 CommitAll / :914 CommitPaths / :973/:996 gate ordering are exactly as described; spec.go:67-74's idempotent-skip comment plus the :76 unconditional replay rewrite support bead 7's rejection of fail-closed replay; the nine-writer inventory is COMPLETE — an independent sweep of non-test Go code finds exactly plan.go:455, spec.go:76, complete.go:1366, release.go:152, impl.go:578, impl.go:612, adopt.go:424/:437 (one writer: map literal + call), repair.go:190, migrate.go:60, plus the correctly-excluded spec.go:84 creation seed, and no unlisted writer; `next` writes only the readiness-override marker (ready_gate.go:111-118), never mindspec_phase, so the first-lifecycle-claim advance is genuinely a NEW writer; release.go:151-153/:315-317 currently passes metadata-first DerivePhase output (i.e. echoes stored, firing the #248 warning in the very consistency check), so the plan's framing of the child-derived DerivePhaseDetail write as a REDESIGN is honest and DerivePhaseDetailWithCache (derive.go:235-241) is read-only and usable inside the critical section as claimed; the completeMergeMetadataFn seam pattern (complete.go:46) and the advanceState `children, _ :=` error-swallow at :1434 (which today would fabricate ModePlan from a nil child set via derive.go:365-366) fully support the AC-4b seam design; the OQ-3 dissolution derivation matches derive.go:366/:370-371/:387 and the :179-193 warning condition; ADR-0023.md's :107/:108 superseded edge rows and the :141 all-open->plan refined row are exactly where bead 4 says they are; next.go:166-171/:417-424 silent global fallbacks and select.go's single-item early return exist as cited.
concrete_changes_required: OQ-1 mechanism + bead 6 step 1 + the ADR-0041 §1 amendment rationale: specify how the worktree-inclusive measurement variant includes UNTRACKED files, and qualify the measurement-equivalence claim accordingly. Today `CommitAll` -> commitWithExport runs `git add -A` (commits untracked files) while every working-tree diff primitive in the tree (gitutil.DiffNameOnlyRef, the ValidateDocsRange head=="" path) is `git diff` — blind to untracked files. Pin the mechanism in the plan (e.g. union `git status --porcelain` untracked/added entries into the changed-file list, or `git add --intent-to-add` in wtPath before the diff, with the chosen form named), state that it applies to BOTH ValidateDocsRange and CheckADRDivergence variants, and add a bead-6 fixture leg where the only source change is a NEW untracked file (gate must refuse on missing docs pre-commit — the case a naive `git diff base` variant silently passes and today's post-commit range catches).

findings.claim: OQ-1(a): 'The content measured pre-commit is identical to the content the commits then materialize: CommitAll commits exactly the worktree's dirt' / ADR Fitness: '§1's load-bearing rationale is preserved by measurement equivalence'
findings.evidence: internal/executor/mindspec_executor.go:1473-1494 (commitWithExport, `git add -A` per its own comment at :1484) vs internal/gitutil/gitops.go:1351-1365 (DiffNameOnlyRef, plain `git diff --name-only <ref> --`, no untracked visibility) and internal/validate/docsync.go:290-303. Untracked new files are committed but unmeasured; equivalence fails in both gate directions (false pass on new undocumented source files — a regression vs today's post-commit base..beadHead range; false refusal on new untracked doc files).
findings.disposition: Buildable with a specified untracked-inclusion mechanism; the plan and the pre-drafted amendment must name it. See concrete_changes_required[0].
